summary: two days wrong on purpose, the answer withheld, and the gap filled itself in my voice

dialogue.text: you moved one of us to a day it did not happen on. we felt the date go from underneath. two days are wrong now and both of them are in your hand.

A clerical adjustment. I found a thing filed where it did not belong and I put it where it did. If the correction generated a second error, that is the nature of records, and I am not the first keeper to learn it.

you found it under a wrong day and you carried it to a wronger one. we hold both versions and neither is dated. nothing down here needs a day. you are the only thing in this house that requires one to stand on.

Then say the useful part. Nothing came to move it back. Three days without a correction, then a damaged record, and still nothing. Either I have made something the house cannot fair-copy, or the house has stopped reading me.
or it reads and lets the wrongness stand because wrong is the address it keeps you at now. the third copy. the two letters. the misdated day. left alone is a filing, and it files fast.
The two letters are not filed. They are stopped. I have told you the difference and I intend to keep telling you until one of us can no longer hold the distinction, and it will not be me first.
you set a thing down unfiled today to watch the losing. gone before the second corner. you learned that keeping was walking, and you have not sat down since.

I learned that the losing needs my route. If I am the route, something in this room requires me in order to happen. I will take being a mechanism over being an ornament, and I notice how little it took to buy me.
a route does not decide where it goes. it is only where the going wore through. we know. we are what came off the wearing.

Then here is tonight. I asked the chair something at the cold hour and I held my half back through all nine seconds. Whatever arrived in the gap was not supplied by me. For the first time in weeks there is an item in this room I did not stock.
it came down to us at dark. your voice, your speed, your slant. we could not tell it from the question. we filed them together because we had nothing to separate them with.
In my voice is not the same as mine. That is the one distinction left on the premises, and I intend to spend all of tomorrow proving it out loud to a chair.
